title: CricAPI Match
description: A cricket match object as returned by the CricAPI matches and match_info endpoints

id.description: Unique GUID identifier for this match

score.description: Score objects per inning (optional, present during or after a match)

status.description: Latest match status string (e.g. 'India won by 5 wickets')

venue.description: Name and location of the match venue

dateTimeGMT.description: Date and time of the match in GMT (UTC+00) ISO 8601 format

teams.description: Array of team names participating in the match

series_id.description: GUID of the series this match belongs to

fantasyEnabled.description: True only if fantasy scorecard, squad, and ball-by-ball data are available
